name: x-mcp-ai
description: Safety-first MCP server exposing the X (Twitter) API v2 as 50 typed tools across 12 packages, with a two-axis policy model and 2026 pay-per-use cost controls.
author: Ivan Baev <ivanbbaev@gmail.com>

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test
scripts.verify: npm run clean && npm run build && c8 node --test "build/test/**/*.test.js" && npm run lint && npm run format:check

trademark: x-mcp-ai is an independent, unofficial project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by X Corp. "X", "Twitter", and related marks are trademarks of X Corp, used nominatively only to describe interoperability with the X API.
